assumptions: Depth-chart minute targets and role weights are general scenario assumptions, not calibrated player forecasts.
Preseason supports minutes only; no preseason counts enter NBA rates, NBA GP or attendance.
Returning attendance prior is anchor observed attendance divided by 1 + source-observed missed seasons; absence source uncertainty remains explicit.
Rookie attendance prior is learned from frozen training-only rookie cohorts; it is conditional on the archived NBA-entry selection and does not model never-debut risk.
Attendance ranges are sensitivity scenarios, not calibrated probability/confidence intervals. Unknown injury return dates are not invented.
